admissible_scope.current_safe_reuse: Immutable observation/topology layout reuse is already separate from learned-state reuse and does not need this proposed DAG computation.
admissible_scope.possible_case: Two occurrences of an identical attributed subtree with identical raw computational inputs and operation order may share the first upward subgraph. No existing metadata establishes enough such cases for a useful speedup.

blockers.detail: Each leaf sees mean/max/count/missingness of the original sites in that hold, using genotype category, donor frequencies/callability,panel frequency and entropy; site_pool_projection also takes that hold physical span. Even empty-site holds can differ through span. A changed leaf input propagates through every ancestor via nonlinear updates.

up_gate uses four edge-geometry fields and five branch-support fields; support is built from the sites assigned to each hold. Equal descendant leaf sets or persistent topology do not establish equal gates.

The first sweep also computes outside states from ancestor outside,ancestor base and sibling aggregate minus recipient message. They cannot be shared from subtree identity alone; forcing uses upward+outside.

The second base includes node flags,episode eligibility and cut-representative injections from complete stable-leaf history. Reusing the first-sweep upward subtree does not authorize reuse of the second sweep,full history,GRU or final context.

A valid shared computation must gather all uses and propagate the sum of every consumer VJP through the shared original graph,including forcing/history and second-sweep paths. Dropping duplicate occurrences,detaching a cache,or reusing values without all gradients changes training.

Cross-occurrence sharing can alter PyG reduction batching and parameter-gradient addition order. Mathematical equivalence is not a bitwise guarantee; original fixed comparisons of context,logits,loss,gradients,updated parameters and Adam remain necessary before use.

correction: The v1 prose equation placed LayerNorm and tanh in the wrong order; v2 matches the source exactly. Conclusions and source references are unchanged.

exact_upward_dependency.outgoing_message: Recompute outgoing child_message using the current root-to-parent gate and current parent degree; those can change under reparenting despite an equal cached subtree state.
exact_upward_dependency.raw_identity: Match observation identity/sample correspondence, node clocks,root/sample flags,leaf site/categorical input computation,edge geometry/support and topology. Equality of a learned output tensor alone does not prove equality of parameter Jacobians.
exact_upward_dependency.scope: For the subtree root upward state itself, its outgoing edge to its parent and the outside/ancestor state are not inputs. Every descendant base, child-edge gate, topology/degree, child accumulation order and fixed parameter version are inputs.

recommendation: Close topology-only subtree caching as an invalid shortcut for this model. Keep feature-complete within-update common-subexpression elimination as an unproven idea only; do not delay current resident/explicit routing deployment or add implementation/benchmarks now.

locations.meaning: _sites: exact hold-local site pooling plus physical span
_second: per-hold flags, episode eligibility and full-history readout injection
Exact inherited PyG upward and outside recurrences
Per-hold branch support and edge geometry construction
Original ordered parameter-VJP accumulation and second-block derivatives
Per-block first/forcing recomputation and VJP order

verdict: Do not reuse upward states by clade identity, tree-sequence node ID or topology alone. Mathematically valid within-update reuse requires the entire attributed upward computation to be identical; current site/span/support inputs vary by marginal hold. Actual duplicate frequency and benefit have not been measured.
